answer: Require each mining identity to present a remote attestation quote from a Trusted Execution Environment on unique hardware. Registration issues exactly one credential per attested device key, so a sybil operator scripting ten thousand accounts needs ten thousand real chips. Emulators cannot forge genuine quotes: at the dawn of each registration the verifier checks the quote chain against manufacturer roots, rejecting anything unsigned. The shale layer of cheap virtual clones crumbles — each identity must sit on physical hardware, and the tide of mass-produced sockpuppets recedes.
